sentences.zh: 突然间，人们开始审视他们过去关于以色列的言论。

sentences.en: Oh, that's really a regrettable way of expressing that.
sentences.zh: 哦，那确实是一种令人遗憾的表达方式。

sentences.en: I don't know how my comments would be offensive to Jewish Americans.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的评论怎么会冒犯美国犹太人。

sentences.en: My comments precisely are addressing what was happening during the Gaza war.
sentences.zh: 我的评论恰恰是在谈论加沙战争期间发生的事情。

sentences.en: That phrasing that Israel had hypnotized the world really kind of plays into these centuries-old anti-Semitic tropes of Jews trying to control the world.
sentences.zh: 那种“以色列催眠了世界”的措辞，确实在某种程度上迎合了几个世纪以来关于犹太人试图控制世界的反犹主义陈词滥调。

sentences.en: Of the sort of manipulative, behind-the-scenes Jew working some kind of magic to influence events.
sentences.zh: 关于那种操纵性的、幕后的犹太人施展某种魔法来影响事件的说法。

sentences.en: The Republicans are looking as well, and they want to exploit what could be these fledgling cracks between Jews and the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 共和党人也在观察，他们想利用犹太人和民主党之间可能出现的这些初步裂痕。

sentences.en: The 116th Congress gabbled in for its first session on Thursday with lawmakers from both congressional branches eager to set their parties agenda.
sentences.zh: 第116届国会周四召开了第一次会议，来自国会两院的议员们都急于制定各自政党的议程。

sentences.en: And the very first bill, S-1 in the Senate, is a Middle East policy bill that allows the punishment of any company that goes along with the boycotting or sanctioning of Israel.
sentences.zh: 而第一项法案，参议院的S-1法案，是一项中东政策法案，允许惩罚任何参与抵制或制裁以色列的公司。

sentences.en: For those who are not familiar with BDS, it's boycott, divestment, and sanction.
sentences.zh: 对于那些不熟悉BDS的人来说，它是抵制、撤资和制裁的缩写。

sentences.en: It is an effort, by and large, to punish Israel.
sentences.zh: 这总体上是一种惩罚以色列的努力。

sentences.en: It's an anti-BDS provision.
sentences.zh: 这是一项反BDS条款。

sentences.en: By convincing companies, international companies, and others, to boycott doing business with Israel or Israeli entities, to divest of investments in Israel or Israeli entities.
sentences.zh: 通过说服公司、国际公司和其他机构，抵制与以色列或以色列实体进行商业往来，撤回在以色列或以色列实体的投资。

sentences.en: They know that they are doing this to try to divide Democrats and Jews, and to try to provoke Ilhan Omar and Rashida Tlaib.
sentences.zh: 他们知道这样做是为了试图分裂民主党人和犹太人，并试图激怒伊尔汗·奥马尔和拉希达·特莱布。

sentences.en: I don't want to be part of a vote that limits the ability for people to fight towards that justice and peace.
sentences.zh: 我不想参与一项限制人们为正义与和平而斗争能力的投票。

sentences.en: They are the only two members of Congress who are openly supporting the boycott movement.
sentences.zh: 她们是国会中仅有的两位公开支持抵制运动的成员。

sentences.en: I cannot imagine our country not having the right to economic boycott.
sentences.zh: 我无法想象我们的国家没有经济抵制的权利。

sentences.en: And lo and behold, Rashida Tlaib falls right into it.
sentences.zh: 瞧，拉希达·特莱布正好掉进了陷阱。

sentences.en: Just a few days after her expletive-laden vow to impeach President Trump, Congresswoman Rashida Tlaib's choice of words is making headlines again,
sentences.zh: 就在她发表充满脏话的弹劾特朗普总统誓言几天后，国会议员拉希达·特莱布的措辞再次成为头条新闻，

sentences.en: this time for what some are calling an anti-Semitic smear.
sentences.zh: 这一次是因为一些人所称的“反犹主义诽谤”。

sentences.en: She actually sends out a tweet suggesting that supporters of this anti-BDS provision don't know what country they're representing.
sentences.zh: 她实际上发了一条推文，暗示这项反BDS条款的支持者不知道他们代表的是哪个国家。

sentences.en: Now even some Democrats are getting uneasy.
sentences.zh: 现在连一些民主党人也开始感到不安了。

sentences.en: We must continue to stand firm against the profoundly biased campaign to delegitimize the state of Israel through boycotts, divestment, and sanctions.
sentences.zh: 我们必须继续坚定立场，反对通过抵制、撤资和制裁来使以色列国丧失合法性的极度偏见的运动。

sentences.en: While Iran publicly executes its citizens, Turkey jails its journalists.
sentences.zh: 当伊朗公开处决其公民时，土耳其监禁其记者。

sentences.en: Scores of Arab nations punish homosexuality with imprisonment and torture.
sentences.zh: 许多阿拉伯国家用监禁和酷刑来惩罚同性恋。

sentences.en: Why does BDS single Israel out alone for condemnation?
sentences.zh: 为什么BDS单单挑出以色列进行谴责？

sentences.en: When the world treats everybody one way and the Jew or the Jewish state another way, there's only one word for it.
sentences.zh: 当世界以一种方式对待所有人，却以另一种方式对待犹太人或犹太国家时，只有一个词可以形容它。

sentences.en: Anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 反犹主义。

sentences.en: Let us call out the BDS movement for what it is.
sentences.zh: 让我们揭露BDS运动的本质。

sentences.en: And then, last week...
sentences.zh: 然后，上周……

sentences.en: A freshman lawmaker is taking heat for remarks that critics are calling anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 一位新晋议员因批评者称之为“反犹主义”的言论而受到抨击。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Ilhan Omar in just her seventh week in office, again enduring sharp backlash after challenging support for Israel.
sentences.zh: 国会议员伊尔汗·奥马尔在上任仅七周后，在挑战对以色列的支持后再次遭到强烈反弹。

sentences.en: Ilhan Omar tweets...
sentences.zh: 伊尔汗·奥马尔发推文说……

sentences.en: In a tweet, Minnesota Democratic Congresswoman Ilhan Omar suggested support for Israel is fueled by money.
sentences.zh: 在一篇推文中，明尼苏达州民主党国会议员伊尔汗·奥马尔暗示对以色列的支持是由金钱驱动的。

sentences.en: Quote, it's all about the Benjamins, baby.
sentences.zh: 引用：“这全是为了本杰明（钱），宝贝。”

sentences.en: There has been swift and fiery response.
sentences.zh: 对此已有迅速而激烈的回应。

sentences.en: This cannot sustain itself.
sentences.zh: 这种情况无法持续下去。

sentences.en: It's unacceptable in this country.
sentences.zh: 在这个国家是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Now it's like a crisis within the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 现在这就像是民主党内部的一场危机。

sentences.en: They say that they condemn what she has said.
sentences.zh: 他们表示谴责她所说的话。

sentences.en: Lawmakers are issuing statements.
sentences.zh: 议员们正在发表声明。

sentences.en: Congresswoman Omar's use of anti-Semitic tropes and prejudicial accusations about Israel's supporters is deeply offensive.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔众议员使用反犹太主义的陈词滥调，并对以色列的支持者进行带有偏见的指责，这是极其冒犯的。

sentences.en: We condemn these remarks and we call upon Congresswoman Omar to immediately apologize.
sentences.zh: 我们谴责这些言论，并呼吁奥马尔众议员立即道歉。

sentences.en: She needs to apologize.
sentences.zh: 她必须道歉。

sentences.en: This is blatant anti-Semitism.
sentences.zh: 这是赤裸裸的反犹太主义。

sentences.en: A newly elected member of Congress is apologizing for criticizing supporters of Israel after a blast from her own party leadership.
sentences.zh: 一位新当选的国会议员在遭到本党领导层的猛烈抨击后，正为批评以色列支持者的言论道歉。

sentences.en: And that's what she does.
sentences.zh: 而这正是她所做的。

sentences.en: She apologizes.
sentences.zh: 她道歉了。

sentences.en: Representative Omar apologized today for the anti-Semitic tweet saying she is, quote, listening and learning.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔众议员今天为那条反犹太主义的推文道歉，称她正在，引用她的话，倾听并学习。

sentences.en: Writing, quote, my intention is never to offend my constituents or Jewish Americans as a whole.
sentences.zh: 她写道，引用她的话，我的本意绝不是冒犯我的选民或整个美国犹太群体。

sentences.en: This is why I unequivocally apologize.
sentences.zh: 这就是我明确道歉的原因。

sentences.en: And Jonathan, what do you make of that?
sentences.zh: 乔纳森，你对此有何看法？

sentences.en: What is inside of these charges against these two Democrats of having trafficked in anti-Semitic troops?
sentences.zh: 针对这两位民主党人涉嫌散布反犹太主义言论的指控，其核心内容是什么？

sentences.en: Well, on the one hand, the language itself sounds anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一方面，这些言论本身听起来确实是反犹太的。

sentences.en: But when is anti-Israel sentiment or anti-Zionist sentiment simply anti-Semitic?
sentences.zh: 但反以色列情绪或反犹太复国主义情绪，在什么时候才单纯等同于反犹太主义呢？

sentences.en: And that is a very difficult, difficult line to draw.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常难以界定的界限。

sentences.en: Some people think that anti-Zionism itself, opposing a Jewish state, is by definition anti-Semitic.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为反犹太复国主义本身，即反对犹太国家，从定义上讲就是反犹太主义。

sentences.en: But other people would say, no, you know, you're allowed to have foreign policy views,
sentences.zh: 但另一些人会说，不，你知道，你有权持有外交政策观点，

sentences.en: even if foreign policy views that some people find reprehensible without being accused of bigotry.
sentences.zh: 即使这些外交政策观点被某些人认为令人反感，也不应被指责为偏执。

sentences.en: And that, hey, you know, Ilhan Omar might really, really not like the Jewish state or what the Jewish state does in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 而且，嘿，你知道，伊尔汗·奥马尔可能真的、真的不喜欢犹太国家，或者不喜欢犹太国家在中东的所作所为。

sentences.en: But that doesn't mean that she hates the Jewish people.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着她仇恨犹太人民。

sentences.en: And an apparatus has existed in Washington now for decades that has pulled both parties into the view that Israel is sacrosanct and that criticism of Israel is tantamount to criticism of Jews.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，华盛顿一直存在一种机制，将两党都拉向这样一种观点：以色列是神圣不可侵犯的，批评以色列就等同于批评犹太人。

sentences.en: Sure, what's fascinating about this is that the Democratic Party, which, as you explained, championed Israel from the beginning, all the way back to 1948,
sentences.zh: 当然，这件事最引人入胜的地方在于，正如你所解释的那样，民主党从一开始，一直追溯到1948年，就一直支持以色列，

sentences.en: is now the party fending off charges of anti-Semitism and the party struggling with questions around how deep its support for Israel goes and how to handle this growing wing of its members who want a different approach,
sentences.zh: 现在却成了那个要抵御反犹太主义指控的政党，也是那个正在纠结于其对以色列的支持到底有多深，以及如何处理党内这股想要采取不同方针的日益壮大的派系问题的政党，

sentences.en: who are unhappy with Israel and its policies and very willing to publicly declare that.
sentences.zh: 他们对以色列及其政策不满，并且非常愿意公开宣示这一点。

sentences.en: I think that Tlaib and Omar are the edge of the next wave.
sentences.zh: 我认为特莱布和奥马尔是下一波浪潮的先锋。

sentences.en: So right now, most Democrats on Capitol Hill are still in lockstep with Israel, but their constituents are not.
sentences.zh: 所以目前，国会山的大多数民主党人仍然与以色列保持高度一致，但他们的选民却并非如此。

sentences.en: And that means that the Democratic Party is going to kind of have to have a reckoning about Israel.
sentences.zh: 这意味着民主党将不得不就以色列问题进行某种清算。

sentences.en: I asked the Democratic caucus chair, Hakeem Jeffries,
sentences.zh: 我问了民主党党团主席哈基姆·杰弗里斯，

sentences.en: whether or not Omar's underlying point that we need to have a more open conversation about Israel is something that Democrats would entertain.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔关于我们需要就以色列问题进行更开放对话的根本观点，是否是民主党人愿意考虑的。

sentences.en: And he was very strident in his answer to me that the Democratic Party stands with Israel.
sentences.zh: 他在回答我时非常坚定地表示，民主党与以色列站在一起。

sentences.en: It was like really the straight party line answer.
sentences.zh: 那真的是非常标准的党派立场回答。

sentences.en: But it's easy to see down the road that there are going to be more Rashidas and Ilhans in the future.
sentences.zh: 但很容易预见，未来会有更多的拉希达和伊尔汗出现。

sentences.en: And progressives who are a rising force within the party are trying to force that discussion.
sentences.zh: 而作为党内一股正在崛起的势力，进步派正试图推动这场讨论。

sentences.en: And many young Jews are trying to force that discussion.
sentences.zh: 许多年轻的犹太人也正试图推动这场讨论。

sentences.en: So at a certain point, Democrats can't avoid this conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以到了一定程度，民主党人无法回避这场对话。

sentences.en: And if you look at it over the long term, it really could herald the breaking of the longstanding bond between Democrats and Israel.
sentences.zh: 如果你从长远来看，这确实可能预示着民主党与以色列之间长期纽带的破裂。

sentences.en: We're not there yet, but you can see it from here.
sentences.zh: 我们还没到那一步，但你已经可以预见到了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Let's bring in Javier Becerra, California's attorney general who is considering a challenge to the president's national emergency in court.
sentences.zh: 让我们请出加州总检察长哈维尔·贝塞拉，他正在考虑在法庭上挑战总统的国家紧急状态。

sentences.en: Mr. Attorney General, let me ask you, can you say definitely that California will be filing a lawsuit and when that will happen?
sentences.zh: 贝塞拉总检察长，请问，你能明确表示加州将会提起诉讼，以及这将在何时发生吗？

sentences.en: Martha, definitely and imminently.
sentences.zh: 玛莎，肯定会，而且很快。

sentences.en: In an interview with ABC's This Week, California Attorney General Javier Becerra said that his lawsuit would be joined by New Mexico, Oregon, Minnesota, New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 在接受美国广播公司《本周》节目采访时，加州总检察长哈维尔·贝塞拉表示，新墨西哥州、俄勒冈州、明尼苏达州、新泽西州、

sentences.en: Hawaii and Connecticut.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷州和康涅狄格州将加入他的诉讼。

sentences.en: You know, the National Emergencies Act gives the president very broad authority on what qualifies an emergency.
sentences.zh: 你知道，《国家紧急状态法》赋予了总统关于何种情况构成紧急状态的非常广泛的权力。

sentences.en: So where do you believe he's really overstepped his bounds given this very vague law?
sentences.zh: 那么，鉴于这项非常模糊的法律，你认为他在哪里真正越界了？

sentences.en: Becerra said that the president's own words in declaring a national emergency on Friday, that he, quote, didn't need to do this, would be used against him in court.
sentences.zh: 贝塞拉表示，总统周五宣布国家紧急状态时自己说的话，即他，引用他的话，不需要这样做，将在法庭上被用来对付他。

sentences.en: Well, he himself said it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他自己也这么说了。

sentences.en: He did not need to announce or declare a crisis.
sentences.zh: 他根本不需要宣布或宣告一场危机。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一批自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人激动的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。

sentences.en: We'll see you next time.
sentences.zh: 我们下次再见。
